messages:
Anya: quick smoke on mint-lite bring-up for embeddings using holdout10k subset
Anya: float32 recall@1/5/10 = 0.62 / 0.79 / 0.86, silhouette = 0.34
Anya: int8 (ONNX, per-channel) recall@1/5/10 = 0.59 / 0.76 / 0.84, silhouette = 0.31
Miles: small drop but probably within our expected delta. what's memory/latency gain?
Anya: latency p95 embed-only: float32 22ms -> int8 9ms. vector RAM down ~55% on host
Devin: did you check idflip counts? any NN swaps that break downstream logic?
Anya: idflip@1 = 3.2% (float baseline) vs 3.9% (int8). I saved top-100 flagged queries where int8 changed correct->wrong
Sophia: can you paste the eval command and a short output snippet?
Anya: sure:
```bash
python eval_embeddings.py --model mint-lite --quant int8 --dataset holdout10k --k 10 --save-outputs out/int8.json
```
Anya: sample diff (qid:422): float32 NN=1001 (label A), int8 NN=1009 (label B) — semantically close but label mismatch
Miles: can we run clustering stability (NMI) and stratify recall by query length? short queries often suffer more
Devin: quick stratified pass I ran: short queries (<=8 tokens) recall@1 drop ~0.07; medium ~0.02; long (>32) negligible
Sophia: actionable: try per-tensor vs per-channel, FP16 baseline, and a calibration set of ~2k to tune ranges. also test clamp/scale options
Anya: schedule: per-tensor int8, fp16, and calibrated per-channel (calib2k). I'll attach diffs and top-100 idflip list when done. tagging @embed-ci-bot
embed-ci-bot: scheduled run 1715059999-embed-int8-calib: per-tensor/int8, fp16, per-channel-calib2k. ETA ~18m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Miles: if calibrated per-channel int8 drops idflip <1% and closes the short-query gap, we can pilot int8 on staging. otherwise keep float32 for critical read-paths
